ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; black pixels are localized to the perimeter trailing edge and two distinct focal interior points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white pixel field across 90% of fluke area; distinct low-intensity circular blob at coordinates [mid-left lobe]; distinct low-intensity circular blob at coordinates [mid-right lobe]; thin non-uniform black banding along the entire trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 40-50 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the total fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels; peaks are predominantly oriented toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips; outer leading edges exhibit a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters (ocellus-like) symmetrically positioned on the ventral surface of each lobe; one smaller dark spot near the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical and diagonal thin gray line segments (low contrast) visible on the medial portion of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent circular scars (likely barnacle attachment sites) on the lower-mid sections of both fluke lobes; irregular jagged scarring on the far-left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique symmetrical pair of large focal dark spots on an otherwise near-pure white fluke surface.
